blurb: Guests can join the Wine Club to receive monthly handcrafted wines, enjoy exclusive dining rewards, and attend members-only events. The winery features a Napa-style tasting room with guided tastings and a scratch kitchen menu paired with wines. Members can also participate in curated wine trips and access premium wine destinations.
extraNote: Membership is month-to-month and can be cancelled anytime with no fees · Wine Club charges billed on the fourth Tuesday of each month · Wine of the Month available for pickup starting fourth Tuesday of prior month · Wine held as long as possible if unable to pick up; swap options available · Delivery option available only in select states · Cooper's Hawk location at 4705 Talmadge Rd, Toledo, OH 43623
